title: Tamsin and the Compass
author: Hazel Villalobos
blurb: Sebastian Winterbourne, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
